name: Tyson Sharpe
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I work with adults who want to better understand their experiences, develop practical ways of coping and make changes that support a more manageable and meaningful life. I am a registered psychologist with experience across private practice, corporate mental health, psychiatry, traumatic injuries, persistent pain and crisis support. I provide trauma-informed, neuroaffirming and gender-affirming care.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Jordan Whitehead
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Jordan Whitehead helps people find steadiness and meaning through life's most challenging transitions. She has over 15 years of experience across public health and private practice as a Registered Psychologist.
specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties, Diverse sexualities

name: Ana Galban Leon
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Do you find yourself overthinking, feeling guilty when you try to set boundaries, or caught in repeating patterns that leave you feeling drained and burnt out? I work with young women who are highly self-aware, yet still find it hard to break out of these cycles. I take a holistic, person-centered approach that combines the mind-body connection with various evidence-based modalities, including EMDR for trauma and Internal Family Systems-informed.
specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities, EMDR

name: Laura Kemppainen
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Laura works with general mental health issues, life-related stresses, trauma-related issues and also provides treatment for eating disorders and body-image related concerns, and is also an ANZAED accredited eating disorders practiioner. She has a collaborative, strength-based therapeutic style with a focus on good listening, shared reflection and growing clarity and skills. She mostly sees children coming for psychosocial issues, anxiety, low mood and shyness, and also sees both adults and young people identifying as LGBTQIA+.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Schema Therapy

name: Tasia-Paris Manuel
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Hello, my name is Tasia (she/her). I am a Psychologist and I help adults who are navigating the impact of intergenerational trauma, complex family dynamics, and identity struggles to reconnect with their authentic selves and build more meaningful, empowered relationships - with others and with themselves.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties, Diverse genders, Sex worker issues, Schema Therapy

name: Jodie Cicaji
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Jodie is a warm, supportive and experienced psychologist who provides a non-judgmental therapeutic space to help clients to build insight, clarity and to find solutions within themselves. She has experience working with a range of issues and mental health conditions including anxiety, depression, PTSD & C-PTSD, adjustment difficulties, study & work stress, attachment & interpersonal difficulties. Clients who are interested in practical, in-depth or experiential approaches (such as Schema Therapy & mindfulness work) may especially find working with Jodie to be a good fit.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Michael Currie

specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues
